statement.text:
Let p be a prime. A group G satisfies the p-minimal condition if there are no
infinite descending chains G1 > G2 > . . . of subgroups of G such that each difference
Gi \ Gi+1 contains a p-element (S. N. Chernikov). Suppose that a locally finite group
G satisfies the p-minimal condition and has a subnormal series each of whose factors is
finite or a p′ -group. Is it true that all p-elements of G generate a Chernikov subgroup?
                                                                         N. S. Chernikov
